sentences: But his eyes held nothing except cold contempt
Then someone crept towards me on soft feet
I sank for ever into the darkness
I caught Tajomaru, the famous bandit, by the stone bridge," said the constable
I heard the bandit comforting her," said Takehiro's spirit through the medium

items.source_sentence: But his eyes held nothing except cold contempt
items.source_sentence_ja: しかし彼の目には、冷たい軽蔑しかなかった。

items.source_sentence: Then someone crept towards me on soft feet
items.source_sentence_ja: そのとき誰かが足音を忍ばせて私に近づいてきた。

items.source_sentence: I sank for ever into the darkness
items.source_sentence_ja: 私は永遠に闇の中へ沈んでいった。

items.source_sentence: I caught Tajomaru, the famous bandit, by the stone bridge," said the constable
items.source_sentence_ja: 「有名な盗賊の多襄丸を石橋のそばで捕らえました」と、巡査は言った。

items.source_sentence: I heard the bandit comforting her," said Takehiro's spirit through the medium
items.source_sentence_ja: 「盗賊が彼女を慰めているのを聞きました」と、霊媒を通して武弘の霊が言った。
